title: Why Pittsburgh?
content: Pittcon 2027 Heyscotty 2026-06-01T19:43:38+00:00 Back in the ‘Burgh! Returning to our home base allows us to tap into an extensive local and regional network, creating new opportunities for meaningful interactions and high-quality leads on the show floor. Meet the New Pittsburgh Heavily driven by advanced manufacturing, emerging technologies, healthcare, higher education, and university start-ups Over 29 colleges and universities, anchored by highly ranked research institutes like Carnegie Mellon University (CMU), Duquesne University, and the University of Pittsburgh (Pitt). Pittsburgh’s leading AI industry is helping transform chemistry by enabling faster analysis of complex data, more efficient materials discovery, and smarter research processes. As AI and chemistry become increasingly interconnected, the region offers chemists valuable opportunities for collaboration, innovation, and entrepreneurship. Major academic and industrial disciplines include AI, Chemistry, Computer Science, Engineering, Health & Life Sciences, Materials Science, Medical Devices, Nanotechnology, and Robotics Corporate R&D headquarters of industrial leaders: Alcoa, Arconic, Calgon Carbon, Covestro, Kraft Heinz, PPG, U.S. Steel, Vitro, and many others U.S. Department of Energy (DOE) Government Labs: National Energy Technology Laboratory (NETL) and Bettis Atomic Power Laboratory Pittcon 2027 Tracks AI & Data Analytics Bioanalytical & Life Sciences Environmental & Energy Forensic Science & Toxicology Instrumentation Innovations & Applications Materials & Nanoscience Pharmaceuticals & Biologics Leadership & Career Development Why Attend Pittcon? Enhanced Guidance from Experts: Learn directly from scientists and innovators. Improved Engagement: Build excitement through immersive and personalized instruction. Advanced Real-World Readiness: Gain confidence using actual lab tools and instrumentation. Increased knowledge Retention: Boost memory and understanding through practical applications. Pittcon’s Conference: Worthy of the City of Champions The Technical Program offers presenters and content unmatched in the lab science industry. Short Courses offer the latest advancement in the field with industry-leading instruments, focusing on the latest trends in Science. Pittcon’s top-notch Employment Service, where you may interview with the top research companies in the world. Networking round tables offer attendees the opportunity to forge bonds of steel with colleagues and attendees, which foster professional and social relationships. Exhibiting at Pittcon puts your brand at the center of the global analytical science community. With thousands of attendees from industry, academia, and government, Pittcon attracts decision-makers actively seeking new technologies, solutions, and partnerships. As an exhibitor, you’ll showcase your products to a highly engaged audience, generate qualified leads, and build meaningful relationships with scientists and influencers shaping the future of laboratory science. Pittcon’s dynamic exhibit floor, technical programming, and networking opportunities create an environment where conversations turn into collaborations and visibility turns into long-term value. Whether you’re launching a new innovation, expanding into new markets, or strengthening your presence with existing customers, Pittcon offers unmatched access, credibility, and return on investment.
